candidate: failed-sweep MSS counterflow absorption and reacceleration

week_selection.method: candidate-specific deterministic Monday selection from unused BTC weeks before any v24 execution

market_representation.event_clock: causal daily equal-notional clock selected from the immediately preceding completed UTC day
market_representation.directional_change_threshold: 40 bps economically derived in the existing intrinsic-time detector

scenario.observation: same-side confirmed intrinsic liquidity is swept, value re-enters, and cumulative aggressive flow reverses
scenario.mss: completed close through the nearest opposing confirmed pivot with aligned aggressive-flow sign
scenario.target_hierarchy: nearest still-unconsumed completed prior-day or prior-week level beyond the deeper of the two latest opposing intrinsic pivots
scenario.absorption: completed equal-notional event has opposite aggressive-flow sign but non-adverse close-to-close movement
scenario.reacceleration: later aligned-flow close crosses the absorbed-event extreme while the MSS level remains held
scenario.entry: market bracket submitted on the first official venue trade strictly after completed reacceleration
scenario.invalidation: complete failed-sweep-to-reacceleration path extreme plus one 7-bp side-cost buffer

execution.market_data: official Binance Vision USD-M aggregate trades converted one-for-one to TradeTick
